_comment: Botania Descriptions - tooltip description lines per item/block. Compound keys (item_id/brew_id) for brew-specific descriptions. Place a copy at config/botania_descriptions.json to override.
_comment_sep_misc_flowers: //========= MISC FLOWERS =========// Non-generating, non-functional. Describe their passive utility.
botania:pure_daisy: Converts adjacent Wood into Livingwood and Stone into Livingrock.
botania:manastar: Reveals whether an adjacent Mana Pool is gaining or losing mana.
Glows blue for a profit, red for a loss.
_comment_sep_gen_flowers: //========= GENERATING FLOWERS =========// Describe what the flower consumes to produce mana and notable mechanics like cooldowns or decay.
botania:endoflame: Burns dropped furnace fuels nearby to produce mana.
Feed it Coal, Charcoal, or similar. Steady early-game source.
botania:hydroangeas: Absorbs adjacent water sources to produce mana.
Low output. Decays after about three in-game days.
botania:thermalily: Absorbs adjacent lava to produce mana.
High burst but long cooldown between absorptions.
botania:rosa_arcana: Absorbs nearby experience orbs to produce mana.
Also drains experience from players standing on it and disenchants dropped enchanted items.
botania:munchdew: Devours leaves above it to produce mana.
Takes a brief digestive break after consuming all leaves in range.
botania:entropinnyum: Absorbs TNT explosions to produce mana.
High yield per blast. Only one explosion per cycle.
botania:kekimurus: Devours Cake blocks placed nearby to produce mana.
Each slice yields mana. More slices per cake means greater yield.
botania:gourmaryllis: Devours food items dropped nearby to produce mana.
Yield scales with nourishment. Alternating different foods grants a bonus.
botania:narslimmus: Slays naturally spawned Slimes nearby to produce mana.
Does not respond to Slimes from spawners.
botania:spectrolus: Consumes Wool dropped nearby in dye color order.
Must be fed the full sequence starting White, Orange, Magenta and onward.
botania:dandelifeon: Runs a Game of Life simulation on a board around it.
Place Cellular Blocks in a pattern. Complex setup, very high output.
botania:rafflowsia: Consumes other Botania flowers dropped nearby for mana.
Yield varies by flower. Alternating different types grants a bonus.
botania:shulk_me_not: Slays a Shulker and its levitating prey together to produce vast mana.
Both must be within range, and the flower's buffer must be empty.
_comment_sep_func_flowers: //========= FUNCTIONAL FLOWERS =========// Describe the effect on world/mobs/items. Petite variants share the exact same description as their base flower.
botania:bellethorn: Strikes nearby hostile and neutral mobs with mana. Ignores players.
botania:bellethorn_chibi: Strikes nearby hostile and neutral mobs with mana. Ignores players.
botania:dreadthorn: Strikes nearby adult animals with mana. Ignores young and other creatures.
botania:heisei_dream: Confuses nearby mobs, turning them against each other.
botania:tigerseye: Repels Creepers from the surrounding area.
botania:jaded_amaranthus: Spawns Mystical Flowers on nearby grass and dirt.
botania:orechid: Transmutes nearby Stone into random ores. Very high mana cost.
botania:orechid_ignem: Transmutes nearby Netherrack into Nether ores. High mana cost.
botania:agricarnation: Hastens crop growth nearby using mana.
botania:agricarnation_chibi: Hastens crop growth nearby using mana.
botania:hopperhock: Collects nearby dropped items into adjacent inventories.
Bind with Item Frames to filter what it gathers.
botania:hopperhock_chibi: Collects nearby dropped items into adjacent inventories.
Bind with Item Frames to filter what it gathers.
botania:tangleberrie: Slows and pulls nearby mobs toward itself.
botania:tangleberrie_chibi: Slows and pulls nearby mobs toward itself.
botania:jiyuulia: Pushes nearby mobs away from itself.
botania:jiyuulia_chibi: Pushes nearby mobs away from itself.
botania:rannuncarpus: Places blocks from adjacent inventories onto nearby ground.
Configure placement with the Wand of the Forest.
botania:rannuncarpus_chibi: Places blocks from adjacent inventories onto nearby ground.
Configure placement with the Wand of the Forest.
botania:hyacidus: Poisons nearby hostile mobs. Does not affect players.
botania:pollidisiac: Feeds and breeds nearby animals using mana.
botania:loonium: Conjures hostile mobs bearing dungeon treasure. Very high mana cost.
botania:daffomill: Pushes dropped items in a chosen direction.
Aim with the Wand of the Forest.
botania:vinculotus: Nearby Endermen warp to this flower instead of randomly.
botania:spectranthemum: Teleports dropped items to a bound location.
Bind destination with the Wand of the Forest.
botania:medumone: Freezes nearby mobs in place. High mana cost.
botania:marimorphosis: Transmutes nearby Stone into biome-specific decorative stone.
botania:marimorphosis_chibi: Transmutes nearby Stone into biome-specific decorative stone.
botania:bubbell: Clears water sources in a sphere, creating an air bubble underwater.
botania:bubbell_chibi: Clears water sources in a sphere, creating an air bubble underwater.
botania:solegnolia: Prevents nearby items from being drawn by magnets.
botania:solegnolia_chibi: Prevents nearby items from being drawn by magnets.
botania:bergamute: Mutes all sounds in a radius around it. Requires no mana.
botania:labellia: Renames items dropped nearby using text from an adjacent Sign.
_comment_sep_runes: //========= RUNES =========// Crafted on Runic Altar. List only the UNIQUE items and flowers that rune unlocks. Omit common shared recipes like Terrasteel armor or Terraform Rod.
botania:rune_water: Crafts Rod of the Seas, Ice Pendant, and Spark Dispersive.
botania:rune_fire: Crafts Rod of the Hells, Smelt Rod, Pyroclast Pendant, and Spark Dominant.
botania:rune_earth: Crafts Rod of the Lands, Temperance Stone, and Laputa Shard.
botania:rune_air: Crafts Bellows, Slingshot, Rod of the Skies, and Spark Isolated.
botania:rune_spring: Crafts Goddess' Charm, Fallen Kanade, Jaded Amaranthus, and Agricarnation.
botania:rune_summer: Crafts Bounce Lens, Gourmaryllis, Narslimmus, Exoflame, and Bubbell.
botania:rune_autumn: Crafts Cloud Pendant, Tigerseye, and Hyacidus.
botania:rune_mana: Crafts Brewery, Mana Blaster, Band of Aura, and Rosa Arcana.
botania:rune_sloth: Crafts Rod of the Shifting Crust, Loonium, and Vinculotus.
botania:rune_wrath: Crafts Damaging Lens, Entropinnyum, Heisei Dream, and Shulk Me Not.
botania:rune_envy: Crafts Entropic Lens, Loonium, Spectranthemum, and Shulk Me Not.
botania:rune_pride: Crafts Diva Charm, Reach Ring, Orechid, Orechid Ignem, and Rafflowsia.
_comment_sep_vials: //========= BREW VIALS =========// Single-use drinkable brews. Describe the bestowed effect, its duration in words, and what it does.
botania:brew_vial/botania:jump_boost: Bestows Jump Boost II for 90 seconds.
botania:brew_vial/botania:regen: Rapidly restores health over a short time.
botania:brew_vial/botania:regen_weak: Slowly restores health over a longer time.
botania:brew_vial/botania:fire_resistanc: Grants immunity to fire and lava.
botania:brew_vial/botania:overload: Bestows Strength IV, Speed III, Weakness II, and Hunger III.
Powerful combat surge with hunger and weakness as its price.
botania:brew_vial/botania:soul_cross: Heals you for a fraction of a slain creature's vitality on each kill.
botania:brew_vial/botania:feather_feet: Cushions falls, greatly reducing fall damage.
botania:brew_vial/botania:emptiness: Prevents hostile creatures from spawning within 128 blocks.
botania:brew_vial/botania:bloodthirst: Forces hostile creatures to spawn within 64 blocks, overriding Emptiness.
botania:brew_vial/botania:allure: Hastens the bite of fish, doubling hook speed.
botania:brew_vial/botania:clear: Purges all potion effects from you.
